<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary conclusion:</strong> The Monsoon Session concluded with 11 of 12 introduced bills passed, though proceedings were marred by frequent disruptions and a final standoff between the NDA and INDIA bloc over issues including Jharkhand protests and Ram Mandir donations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQVU9EeEl6X2FSSWU1UFdMYTBSeWI1TVNtM2t5UHNTZDUzb3dWb2VKYmZzSWhQbGRfUWgtdHRMb01nM0RrRFdHVnppVjU1b203M2pvWWJxNDBxeDBOcGpycXJDM1NVM0d3MWdDeGJUN2JYSHJ6c01ZUWo2cGZRN3BLWjcyS1lyX0d4VjBpa0tpVmpESmpMQ01iNTNLQTRWOUpuajFxZ3d1U2FOWkFNQTVJdGZtTQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition boycott:</strong> The INDIA bloc boycotted the Lok Sabha Speaker’s tea party following the session&#x27;s adjournment, while government ministers, including Kiren Rijiju, blamed the Congress for low productivity and legislative disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Education and health oversight:</strong> A parliamentary panel flagged a &quot;drastic decline&quot; in school retention, noting that 73% of students drop out before higher secondary education, while the Supreme Court issued a final directive to the FSSAI regarding mandatory front-of-pack warning labels for high-sugar, salt, and fat foods.</li>
  <li><strong>Legislative updates:</strong> Parliament successfully passed the Mines and Minerals Amendment Bill, 2026, amidst the broader backdrop of heated political exchanges regarding the absence of key ministers during critical debates.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNcER1dW1hYnN3OEUyWGRMYUxrU3hINGVhME1ydDdqbTE0V3RzdUdMb0xXcFdFTEtWaG5fdnpsbkxWUHI4MFg2Nkg3NFpiSE9JUE9uQ2lJdEZnRDdzTHlYZDRDZjJkTUhkS3dsUTNMLTIxSm5ad0xEOGI3cnF3cW9nMEE4OUxKMFE4QzFIQ1BoWTFwdkg3TUdNSVB6U0syZW52cnViQzFoQmREMUtS?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOcWVmdmItSWZqcHNRaXFYd1dMNFVsaUFfWmRLdllsU3FqdEp0Nm5IWkZNSWxPQ1VZSzhsaW5UNHFkdFJQZkQ4SVBMRTU5enJrQk9TQVI3RDh4ckFpT3VyMHN5YWRrUkl3cFdIbS1LazY4ZnBEZ0pRdHVYMDlyQUVZSVpiWVE5aV9HRDdrSXc1MkJGckpiX0dPdFZ0WFZOd3pfMEhDX3p5RHBPQ3pyN2NoQ2tQdEdlbjM0anVOYkw1Yw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
